title: Researchers train AI to detect concealed handguns using Wi-Fi signals — open-source WiFireNet achieves precision detection on older 802.11a standard by analyzing how weapons distort wireless signals
hook_text: Wi-Fi routers can now spot hidden guns.
script:
An open-source AI called WiFireNet detects concealed handguns by tracking wireless signal disturbances.
It works by analyzing how metal weapons distort wireless signals bouncing through indoor environments.
Researchers specifically trained the detection model to run on the older 802.11a wireless standard.
This allows security teams to achieve precision weapon detection using standard network infrastructure without cameras.
Traditional surveillance relied on expensive metal detectors and optical cameras to scan public spaces.
Would you trust a standard Wi-Fi router to secure your building?
